parent_preserved.sample_grid: 401 chord parameters x 121 stations per skin

locked_dimensions.note: outline deviation = max |X - X_outline(h)| at the same height Z (h = (Z - 240)/5), 4,400 heights per branch up to 1 - h = 2e-8 (Z within 0.1 micrometre of the crown; above that the comparison is limited by round-off in Z), both perimeter branches of both cap faces; the normal distance to the outline is never larger. The crown point itself is compared separately.

joins.note: skin and cap are evaluated at the same chord parameter (the cap reuses the parent's u parameter); projection gap is an independent check. Curvature: second fundamental form of both faces in a common orthonormal tangent frame (e1 along the join). The perimeter is the shared edge of the +Y and -Y cap patches; it ends at the collapsed crown pole and is sampled up to v = 1 - 1e-4 (7 micrometres from the crown); closer than that the degenerate parametrization loses the second derivatives to round-off (crown curvature from the limit is reported under curvature_map).

upper.grid: 860 u x 759 v (u dense toward both ends, v up to 1 - 1e-4)

lower.grid: 860 u x 759 v (u dense toward both ends, v up to 1 - 1e-4)

curvature_map.rule: required radius = 0.4 mm where the attachment thickness at the point's sweep-following chord fraction (X - LE(Z))/c(Z) is >= 0.8 mm, else half that thickness (full half-round)

sections.note: section radius = curvature of the planar cut curve; where the plane is far from containing the surface normal (cos_plane_to_surface_normal small: the plane grazes the surface) it exceeds the surface's own curvature by 1/cos. Surface radius = 1/(larger principal curvature) at trace points. Traces start at Z = 235 on the parent skin; samples within 0.01 mm of the collapsed crown pole are skipped.

zebra.note: phase p = (R . A)/period with R the view ray reflected about the exact CAD normal and A a stripe axis normal to the view; 40 views (+/-Y sides, azimuth -60..60, elevation -30..60) x 6 stripe axes; only points visible from the view on both faces count. Gradient from the exact shape operator. The perimeter join is sampled up to v = 1 - 1e-6 from the collapsed crown, where surface derivatives are undefined. Gradient difference is relative to the larger of the two gradient magnitudes (floored at 1e-3 stripe periods per mm).

pictures.note: orthographic, exact CAD normals on dense parameter grids (no tessellation), no edge lines, back faces culled; camera and stripes fixed in verify_cap.py
